extra.reason: Added Census.Rules/Analyze/Find; Build now shares Analyze. 22 new tests incl. agreement with chart counts.

Player finder complete: Census.Find engine, roster online status, Finder tab with role/profession/dungeon/level/online filters, and Forever dungeon level ranges.
